from z3 import *

# All constraints reference the certificate object `x` (and its flags/fields).
# We model the relevant boolean predicates as uninterpreted Booleans and the
# flag bits as bit-vector/Int values. Since the task asks to convert the
# constraints affecting `x`, we keep `x`-related predicates symbolic.

# --- Flag bits (cflag) ---
cflag = BitVec('cflag', 32)

X509_FLAG_NO_HEADER     = BitVecVal(0x1, 32)
X509_FLAG_NO_VERSION    = BitVecVal(0x2, 32)
X509_FLAG_NO_SERIAL     = BitVecVal(0x4, 32)
X509_FLAG_NO_SIGNAME    = BitVecVal(0x8, 32)
X509_FLAG_NO_ISSUER     = BitVecVal(0x10, 32)
X509_FLAG_NO_VALIDITY   = BitVecVal(0x20, 32)
X509_FLAG_NO_SUBJECT    = BitVecVal(0x40, 32)
X509_FLAG_NO_PUBKEY     = BitVecVal(0x80, 32)
X509_FLAG_NO_EXTENSIONS = BitVecVal(0x100, 32)
X509_FLAG_NO_IDS        = BitVecVal(0x200, 32)
X509_FLAG_NO_SIGDUMP    = BitVecVal(0x400, 32)

# --- Symbolic predicates for the certificate `x` and related values ---
# These represent the C function calls / pointer checks in the constraints.
# We treat them as uninterpreted Booleans (true == success / non-null / >0).
sig_alg        = Bool('sig_alg')          # sig_alg pointer non-null
sig            = Bool('sig')              # sig pointer non-null
suid           = Bool('suid')             # suid != NULL
iuid           = Bool('iuid')             # iuid != NULL
xpoid          = Bool('xpoid')            # xpoid pointer non-null
bs             = Bool('bs')               # serial number buffer non-null
l              = Int('l')                 # version value
nmindent       = Int('nmindent')
nmflags        = Int('nmflags')
printok        = Int('printok')
mlch           = Int('mlch')

# Function-call success predicates (true means the call returned > 0 / == 0 as required)
X509_signature_print_ok        = Bool('X509_signature_print_ok')
X509V3_extensions_print_ok     = Bool('X509V3_extensions_print_ok')
X509_signature_dump_ok         = Bool('X509_signature_dump_ok')
BIO_printf_ok                  = Bool('BIO_printf_ok')
BIO_puts_ok                    = Bool('BIO_puts_ok')
BIO_write_ok                   = Bool('BIO_write_ok')
i2a_ASN1_OBJECT_ok             = Bool('i2a_ASN1_OBJECT_ok')
X509_NAME_print_ex_ok          = Bool('X509_NAME_print_ex_ok')
ossl_asn1_time_print_ex_ok     = Bool('ossl_asn1_time_print_ex_ok')
ossl_serial_number_print_ok    = Bool('ossl_serial_number_print_ok')

s = Solver()

# Helper: "flag bit is set"  ->  (cflag & FLAG) != 0
def flag_set(flag):
    return (cflag & flag) != 0

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Constraint 1: !(!(cflag & X509_FLAG_NO_SIGDUMP)) || !(X509_signature_print(...) <= 0)
#   If SIGDUMP flag is set, X509_signature_print must succeed (> 0).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_SIGDUMP), X509_signature_print_ok))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Constraint 2: !(!(cflag & X509_FLAG_NO_EXTENSIONS) && !X509V3_extensions_print(...))
#   If EXTENSIONS flag is set, X509V3_extensions_print must succeed.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_EXTENSIONS), X509V3_extensions_print_ok))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Constraints 3-6: IDS block (suid / iuid)
#   If IDS flag is set and suid != NULL, signature dump + BIO_printf must succeed.
#   If IDS flag is set and iuid != NULL, signature dump + BIO_printf must succeed.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
s.add(Implies(And(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_IDS), suid), X509_signature_dump_ok))
s.add(Implies(And(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_IDS), suid), BIO_printf_ok))
s.add(Implies(And(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_IDS), iuid), X509_signature_dump_ok))
s.add(Implies(And(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_IDS), iuid), BIO_printf_ok))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Constraints 7-10: PUBKEY block
#   If PUBKEY flag is set, BIO_puts, i2a_ASN1_OBJECT, BIO_printf, BIO_write
#   must all succeed.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_PUBKEY), BIO_puts_ok))
s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_PUBKEY), i2a_ASN1_OBJECT_ok))
s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_PUBKEY), BIO_printf_ok))
s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_PUBKEY), BIO_write_ok))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Constraints 11-13: SUBJECT block
#   If SUBJECT flag is set, BIO_write, X509_NAME_print_ex, BIO_printf succeed.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_SUBJECT), BIO_write_ok))
s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_SUBJECT), X509_NAME_print_ex_ok))
s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_SUBJECT), BIO_printf_ok))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Constraints 14-19: VALIDITY block
#   If VALIDITY flag is set, BIO_write, ossl_asn1_time_print_ex (twice),
#   BIO_write (twice more) must succeed.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_VALIDITY), BIO_write_ok))
s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_VALIDITY), ossl_asn1_time_print_ex_ok))
s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_VALIDITY), BIO_write_ok))
s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_VALIDITY), ossl_asn1_time_print_ex_ok))
s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_VALIDITY), BIO_write_ok))
s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_VALIDITY), BIO_write_ok))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Constraints 20-22: ISSUER block
#   If ISSUER flag is set, BIO_write, X509_NAME_print_ex, BIO_printf succeed.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_ISSUER), BIO_write_ok))
s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_ISSUER), X509_NAME_print_ex_ok))
s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_ISSUER), BIO_printf_ok))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Constraints 23-24: SIGNAME block
#   If SIGNAME flag is set, X509_signature_print and BIO_puts succeed.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_SIGNAME), X509_signature_print_ok))
s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_SIGNAME), BIO_puts_ok))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Constraints 25-27: SERIAL block
#   If SERIAL flag is set, BIO_puts, ossl_serial_number_print, BIO_write succeed.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_SERIAL), BIO_puts_ok))
s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_SERIAL), ossl_serial_number_print_ok))
s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_SERIAL), BIO_write_ok))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Constraints 28-29: VERSION block
#   If VERSION flag is set:
#     - if l is out of [X509_VERSION_1, X509_VERSION_3], BIO_printf must succeed
#     - if l is in range, BIO_printf must succeed
#   Combined: if VERSION flag set, BIO_printf must succeed regardless of l.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
X509_VERSION_1 = 0
X509_VERSION_3 = 2
s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_VERSION), BIO_printf_ok))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Constraints 30-31: HEADER block
#   If HEADER flag is set, BIO_write must succeed (twice).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_HEADER), BIO_write_ok))
s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_HEADER), BIO_write_ok))

# Print the resulting script state (for inspection)
print(s)

def check_constraints():

    # --- Base script variables and constraints ---
    x = Int('x')

    # --- Constraint set 2 variables ---
    cflag = BitVec('cflag', 32)

    X509_FLAG_NO_HEADER     = BitVecVal(0x1, 32)
    X509_FLAG_NO_VERSION    = BitVecVal(0x2, 32)
    X509_FLAG_NO_SERIAL     = BitVecVal(0x4, 32)
    X509_FLAG_NO_SIGNAME    = BitVecVal(0x8, 32)
    X509_FLAG_NO_ISSUER     = BitVecVal(0x10, 32)
    X509_FLAG_NO_VALIDITY   = BitVecVal(0x20, 32)
    X509_FLAG_NO_SUBJECT    = BitVecVal(0x40, 32)
    X509_FLAG_NO_PUBKEY     = BitVecVal(0x80, 32)
    X509_FLAG_NO_EXTENSIONS = BitVecVal(0x100, 32)
    X509_FLAG_NO_IDS        = BitVecVal(0x200, 32)
    X509_FLAG_NO_SIGDUMP    = BitVecVal(0x400, 32)

    sig_alg    = Bool('sig_alg')
    sig        = Bool('sig')
    suid       = Bool('suid')
    iuid       = Bool('iuid')
    xpoid      = Bool('xpoid')
    bs         = Bool('bs')
    l          = Int('l')
    nmindent   = Int('nmindent')
    nmflags    = Int('nmflags')
    printok    = Int('printok')
    mlch       = Int('mlch')

    X509_signature_print_ok     = Bool('X509_signature_print_ok')
    X509V3_extensions_print_ok  = Bool('X509V3_extensions_print_ok')
    X509_signature_dump_ok      = Bool('X509_signature_dump_ok')
    BIO_printf_ok               = Bool('BIO_printf_ok')
    BIO_puts_ok                 = Bool('BIO_puts_ok')
    BIO_write_ok                = Bool('BIO_write_ok')
    i2a_ASN1_OBJECT_ok          = Bool('i2a_ASN1_OBJECT_ok')
    X509_NAME_print_ex_ok       = Bool('X509_NAME_print_ex_ok')
    ossl_asn1_time_print_ex_ok  = Bool('ossl_asn1_time_print_ex_ok')
    ossl_serial_number_print_ok = Bool('ossl_serial_number_print_ok')

    s = Solver()

    def flag_set(flag):
        return (cflag & flag) != 0

    # --- Base script constraint ---
    s.add(x == 0)

    # --- Constraint set 2 constraints ---
    s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_SIGDUMP), X509_signature_print_ok))

    s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_EXTENSIONS), X509V3_extensions_print_ok))

    s.add(Implies(And(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_IDS), suid), X509_signature_dump_ok))
    s.add(Implies(And(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_IDS), suid), BIO_printf_ok))
    s.add(Implies(And(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_IDS), iuid), X509_signature_dump_ok))
    s.add(Implies(And(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_IDS), iuid), BIO_printf_ok))

    s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_PUBKEY), BIO_puts_ok))
    s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_PUBKEY), i2a_ASN1_OBJECT_ok))
    s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_PUBKEY), BIO_printf_ok))
    s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_PUBKEY), BIO_write_ok))

    s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_SUBJECT), BIO_write_ok))
    s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_SUBJECT), X509_NAME_print_ex_ok))
    s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_SUBJECT), BIO_printf_ok))

    s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_VALIDITY), BIO_write_ok))
    s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_VALIDITY), ossl_asn1_time_print_ex_ok))
    s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_VALIDITY), BIO_write_ok))
    s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_VALIDITY), ossl_asn1_time_print_ex_ok))
    s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_VALIDITY), BIO_write_ok))
    s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_VALIDITY), BIO_write_ok))

    s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_ISSUER), BIO_write_ok))
    s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_ISSUER), X509_NAME_print_ex_ok))
    s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_ISSUER), BIO_printf_ok))

    s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_SIGNAME), X509_signature_print_ok))
    s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_SIGNAME), BIO_puts_ok))

    s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_SERIAL), BIO_puts_ok))
    s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_SERIAL), ossl_serial_number_print_ok))
    s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_SERIAL), BIO_write_ok))

    s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_VERSION), BIO_printf_ok))

    s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_HEADER), BIO_write_ok))
    s.add(Implies(flag_set(X509_FLAG_NO_HEADER), BIO_write_ok))

    return s.check() == sat
